# @elata-biosciences/biosignal-analytics

Browser-native biosignal analytics: versioned metric registry, WASM EEG window
features, HRV/statistics, headline scores. Works standalone (no server, no
App Store). Records come from @elata-biosciences/biosignal-session.

Entries: "." (all), "./registry", "./insights", "./worker", "./testing",
"./wasm/*".

Core API:
- initAnalyticsWasm(input?) / initAnalyticsWasmSync — one-time WASM init.
- analyzeEeg({samples, sampleRateHz, channels, windows?, config?}) ->
  { perWindow, observations, summary, provenance }. samples are interleaved
  samples[sampleIdx][channelIdx]; windows default 30s/5s step.
- EegWindowFeatureExtractor — per-window extractor; bandRatio helper.
- hrvTimeDomain(ibisMs) — meanNn/sdnn/rmssd over cleaned NN intervals
  (nn_clean@1 + hrv_time_domain@1).
- statistics: summary stats + robust (median/MAD/percentiles).
- registry: REGISTRY_V1, getMetricDefinition(id), listMetrics(filter),
  ALGORITHM_VERSIONS/ALGORITHM_IDS; MetricDefinitionV1, MetricObservationV1,
  ProvenanceV1, EvidenceTier, MeasurementClass.
- insights: robustZ, BaselineProvider/PersonalBaseline,
  scoreMeasurementQuality, scoreActivation, scoreRecovery — all return
  HeadlineScoreV1 with contributors[] and value:null + withheldReason when
  inputs/baseline/quality are insufficient (never a neutral 50).
- worker: createAnalyticsWorkerClient({port | createWorker}),
  launchAnalyticsWorker (separate module — import.meta, not jest-parseable),
  ANALYTICS_WORKER_PROTOCOL_VERSION, request/response guards.

Discipline: every displayed metric maps to a registry definition with unit,
evidence tier, algorithm@version, quality gates, aggregation policy;
observations carry provenance and are recomputable. Deterministic features are
parity-tested against committed Python (NumPy/SciPy) oracle fixtures in
fixtures/ with declared tolerances, across Rust + WASM + TS.

Rust: crates/elata-biosignal-features (+ -wasm) implement welch_psd@1,
eeg_band_power@2, spectral_entropy@1, dominant_frequency@1, alpha_peak@2,
hjorth@1, window_stats@1, eeg_quality_flags@1, reusing elata-eeg-signal FFT.
Build WASM: pnpm run build:wasm (needs rust >= 1.94 + wasm-bindgen).
